title: fix(app-shell): a create draft shows the spec seed's structural defaults before the first save (objectui#12866)
body:
Fixes #12866
Clause-②: no

## What changed

A new dataset's designer read Measures 0 before the first save, while the save wrote the spec create seed's `count` measure. The create page now puts the seed's STRUCTURAL defaults into its draft, so the designer shows before the first save what the save writes.

- `createBody.ts`: new exported `seedStructuralDefaults(seed)`, the seed minus its placeholder identity (`seedPlaceholderKeys`, objectui#12810). `buildCreateModeBody` now calls it for its base instead of repeating the copy-and-delete inline. The save body is byte-for-byte what it was: same keys removed, same `{ ...base, ...draft }` spread, same `createDefaults` fallback when the server sends no seed.
- `ResourceEditPage.tsx`: one effect in create mode. When the `/meta/types` entry carries a `createSeed`, it adds the seed's structural keys to the draft, once, and only for keys the draft does not hold yet. A type with `createBuildBody` (view) is not seeded. The values are copied (`structuredClone`), so the designer never patches the registry entry's own arrays.

## Where the seed becomes available (mechanism assumption A1, measured)

Async. `useMetadataTypes` starts with `entries: []` and fills them from `client.listTypes()` inside a `useEffect`, so the draft's `useState` initializer always runs before the entry exists. The seeding is therefore on arrival, not at init. The effect also covers an entry that is already present at mount, which is how the existing page tests serve it.

Why "keys the draft does not hold" is the rule: `buildCreateModeBody` spreads the draft over the seed, so a key the draft holds is saved from the draft, and an absent key is exactly the one the save fills from the seed. Adding only absent keys keeps the before-save view equal to the save body, and never overwrites anything the author (or `createDefaults`) set first.

## Tests

New: `ResourceEditPage.createDraftSeed-12866.test.tsx`, through the real `MetadataResourceEditPage` with the real dataset designer, over a real `MetadataClient` on an in-memory server. The type-registry hook can hold the entry back and release it, the way the live one arrives.

- (a) entry served at mount: Measures reads 1 and a measure named `count` is shown before save; after naming the dataset and picking a base object, the saved body's `measures` equals the seed's.
- (a) entry arriving after the first render: Measures reads 0, then 1 once the registry answers; the saved body carries the seed's measures.
- (b) CONTROL: the Label box is empty, the seed's `label` is not displayed anywhere, and the seed's placeholder object appears nowhere on the page.
- (c) a measure the author added before the registry answered is still the only measure after it does (no `count` overwrite).

Two existing page-level pins (`ResourceEditPage.seedPlaceholder-12810.test.tsx`, `inspectors/DatasetDefaultInspector.firstPickKeepsCount-12848.test.tsx`) queried the single textbox named Name. The seeded `count` row now has a Name textbox of its own, so both now read the first one, which is the dataset's. Nothing they assert changed.

Ablation, run with the fix committed, through `ablation-replace.mjs` (anchor must hit, restore proven by blob hash):

- Seeding dropped (the effect's guard replaced by a bare `return`): blob `8f81c0af5620` to `7ef7355f8dc8`, both (a) tests and (b) red, (c) green (it cannot fail when nothing is seeded). Restored: blob equals HEAD `8f81c0af5620`, `git diff HEAD` empty.
- Seeding mutated to overwrite keys the draft holds: (c) red, the other three green. Restored the same way.

## Gates (at `7e7a0b67fb`)

- Closure build `pnpm --workspace-concurrency=2 --filter '@object-ui/app-shell^...' build`: exit 0.
- `pnpm --filter @object-ui/app-shell type-check` (`tsc --noEmit` and `tsc -p tsconfig.test.json`): exit 0. `--listFilesOnly` confirms the new test file is in the test project.
- vitest, the `packages/app-shell/src/views/metadata-admin/` directory: 544 files, 6130 passed, 1 skipped, exit 0. A whole-package `packages/app-shell/` run was stopped after about 29 minutes with no output under `--maxWorkers=1`. It is declared to CI, not measured here.
- `eslint --no-inline-config` on the five changed files: `ResourceEditPage.tsx` has 3 errors and 57 warnings, the same count as that file at the base commit (`react-hooks/static-components`, on lines this PR does not touch). The other four files have 0 errors and 0 warnings. The eslint config enables no type-aware linting, so this diff cannot change the verdict on any untouched file.
- Pre-tsc battery: `check:phantom-deps`, `self-import`, `unreferenced-sources`, `doc-example-readers`, `handler-key-reads`, `side-effects-array`, `element-data-source-declaration`, `spec-symbols`, `action-forward-parity`, `designer-field-key-parity`, `icon-record-names`, `i18n-keys`, `i18n-drift`, `i18n-designer-parity`, `control-bytes`, `check-hand-rolled-comment-mask.mjs`, `check-changeset-fixed.mjs`, `check-changeset-presence.mjs` and `check:new-line-citations` all exit 0.
- `check:spec-floors`: exit 1, NOT MEASURED. Its five findings are all `no-artifact` (packages with no build output in this worktree, app-shell among them), not a floor verdict.

## Acceptance notes

- The card's screenshot (acceptance 2) is the maintainer's. None is attached here.
- Every type with a spec seed and no `createBuildBody` now shows its structural seed keys in the create draft. In each case the save already wrote these values. Examples: object `pluralLabel: New Objects` (the label-to-plural derivation still replaces it as the author types a label), agent `role` and `instructions`, email template `subject` and `bodyHtml`, tool `description`, mapping's sample `fieldMapping` row, action `type` and `body`. Whether some of these are placeholders rather than structure is a question about `seedPlaceholderKeys` (objectui#12810), which this PR shares and does not change.
- Edge case: a key the author set and then removed before the registry answered is absent from the draft, so it is filled from the seed. That matches what the save does for an absent key.
- The header of `ResourceEditPage.seedPlaceholder-12810.test.tsx` still says the object picker resets `measures` on the first change. That has been out of date since objectui#12848 and is left as it is.
